claims.claim_text: Extra airtime creates artificial quality advantage; money-driven exposure contaminates judging

claims.claim_text: Matthew effect magnifies small differences; court at 20 beats missing by one year
claims.evidence_quote: Robert Merton called this the Matthew Effect ... secures a court position at age 20 ... missed that appointment by one year
claims.reasoning: Attribution to Merton plus the age-20 versus one-year illustration match.

claims.claim_text: Producers get uncorrelated quality and capital; consumers add exposure and social signals; success feeds back
claims.evidence_quote: quality score drawn randomly ... capital score drawn independently ... Quality and capital are uncorrelated ... Success feeds back into more exposure
claims.reasoning: Uncorrelated endowments, opinion formation, and feedback loop all stated.

claims.reasoning: All scale figures match with about and plus qualifiers intact.
